text:
hana: Posted the postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2432101234. We need concrete owners for follow-ups (token validation, perms cleanup, audit re-ingest, secrets rotation) and a weekly drift watch. Claim and add a 1-line runbook smoke check.

mike: I'll take token validation (fix TTL mismatch and refresh race). ETA: 2026-04-04. Smoke: `pytest tests/unit/test_token_validation.py::test_ttl_mismatch -q`

keiko: I'll own permissions cleanup for the emergency-role bindings. Plan: inventory, remove excess binds, and add a CI test to block future wide grants. ETA: 2026-04-08. Smoke: `kubectl get rolebinding -A -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.roleRef.name=="emergency-admin")'`

rupert: I'll handle audit pipeline repair and backfill. Two steps: reingest missing Authenticate events (48h window) and add schema validation to drop malformed events to DLQ. Backfill ETA: 2026-03-31; validator PR ETA: 2026-04-05. Smoke: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit WHERE protoPayload.methodName=\"Authenticate\" AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)`

hana: Secrets rotation — who can run a staging canary and update runbook with HSM import notes?

mike: I can coordinate the staging canary for SA keys, but need infra assistance on HSM import. Plan: rotate one staging key, exercise jobs, then prod rotate during a maintenance window. Staging rotate ETA: 2026-03-29, prod by 2026-04-01. Runbook smoke: `kubectl get secret sa-key -n default -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.createdAt}'`

keiko: I'll add the CI guard for RBAC and include a short rollback command in the runbook: `kubectl apply -f rbac/rollback-limited.yaml`

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-1402: "AuthN/AuthZ follow-ups & drift watch". Claimed: token-hardening (mike), perms-cleanup (keiko), audit-backfill (rupert). Added recurrence: weekly drift job (cron: 0 08 * * 1). Link: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-1402

hana: Consolidated checklist (update SEC-1402 as you progress):

- [ ] Token validation hardening (race + TTL unification) — owner: mike — due: 2026-04-04
- [ ] Permissions cleanup + CI guard — owner: keiko — due: 2026-04-08
- [ ] Audit backfill (48h) + schema validator — owner: rupert — due: 2026-03-31 (backfill) / 2026-04-05 (validator)
- [ ] Secrets staging canary + runbook HSM notes — owner: mike + infra — due: 2026-03-29 (staging) / 2026-04-01 (prod)
- [ ] Weekly drift monitor (alert on TTL divergence >10s and missing Authenticate events) — owner: sec-bot (SRE) — recurring weekly

mike: ACK. I'll open a PR for token fixes + add the runbook smoke snippet.

rupert: Starting a small staging backfill now, will report to SEC-1402 if malformed rate >4%.

keiko: Inventory posted in SEC-1402. Will submit RBAC PR by EOD tomorrow.

hana: We'll review SEC-1402 in the next security sync. If anyone hits infra/HSM blockers, tag #eng-oncall and DM me. :thumbsup:
